summary.index: anomaly: accumulation minus the cell's own day-of-year normal
summary.season_loss_cost_note: Share of maximum exposure paid in the analysed event. NOT a rate on line: one event is one observation.
summary.calibration_status: Per-cell Gumbel return levels on the anomaly index, fitted to each cell's own 15 annual maxima. Thresholds are in the index's own units and cancel IMERG's under-read only because measurement and threshold share an instrument.
summary.source_caveat: IMERG Final lags ~3.5 months: backtest and pricing only. The Early run at ~4 h is the live path and is not what this POC runs on.
summary.index_caveat: Pluvial flood only - rain outpacing drainage, not rivers leaving channels. Values are ~100 km2 cell averages reading 43-56% of a gauge in the same cell.
summary.return_period_caveat: Return periods are this index's own. NIWA assessed the 27 January 2023 rainfall as at least 1-in-200 at a gauge; the same event is roughly 1-in-7 for a 100 km2 cell average. A tier is 'the 1-in-N event for a 100 km2 cell as measured by IMERG', never 'a 1-in-N rainfall'.

prediction.reason: event-level insured losses are published for this flood, but no per-location loss series is wired; not fabricated

hazard.reason: Auckland Council operates 60+ telemetered gauges; archive access is not yet arranged, so the gap is quoted from the 2026-09-01 probe rather than measured per cell
hazard.probe_note: IMERG read 43% of the gauge at 6 h and 56% at 24 h at Albert Park
